results.content: # Information on the Processing of Personal Data. At Ray Service we recognize that you, our customers, partners and others who visit the Ray Service website, value your privacy. As in some cases we require your personal data which we further process, we carefully protect the personal data and handle this data in full compliance with the applicable legislation. By means of this notification, we hereby inform you on the processing of your personal data. It regulates the obligations of **the controller** of personal data (Ray Service), but also the rights that **the subjects** of personal data (you as a customer, visitor, etc.) have. ## **Reason and purpose and legal basis for the processing of personal data**. The main reason for processing your personal data is, in particular, the efficient performance of our business activities and communication with you. ## **Period of the processing of personal data**.
